title: Website design and redesign for small businesses
description: Website design and redesign for Los Angeles and Orange County businesses. Mobile-first layouts, useful service pages and clear paths to calls and enquiries.
eyebrow: Website design · Los Angeles & Orange County
intro: Give customers a clear view of your services and an easy next step. Picshaw designs and redesigns small business websites around the journey from a first visit to a call, enquiry or quote request.

sections.title: Choose a website design scope that fits your business
paragraphs: A website refresh suits a business with accurate service information that needs stronger design, mobile usability or a clearer contact journey. A broader website redesign can reorganise navigation, introduce service pages and support an expanded offer. We review your current site, priorities and platform before recommending the scope.

For a new small business website, the first decisions are the audience, services and primary action. A contractor may prioritise estimate requests, while a venue may need a clear route to an availability enquiry. Those decisions shape the page structure, copy and design.

sections.title: Mobile-first pages with a clear conversion path
paragraphs: We bring together visual design, useful content and the practical steps a visitor takes to get in touch. The agreed work can include a mobile-first layout, click-to-call links, quote forms, page titles, headings, descriptions and basic analytics setup. Your written scope identifies the pages and functionality included.
bullets: Explain your offer and service area on the first screen.
Connect service information, genuine project evidence and relevant buyer questions.
Use clear buttons and forms that suit the enquiry you want.
Test mobile navigation, form delivery, error messages and confirmations before launch.

sections.title: Plan the launch around your existing website
paragraphs: We identify important pages and review available search data before changing the structure. When URLs change, the launch scope includes relevant redirects and updated internal links. This gives visitors and search systems a route from the previous pages to the appropriate new content.

Tell us about your domain, hosting, email and booking tools during scoping. We agree access, launch responsibilities and the handoff before scheduling the change. Search data after launch helps us review how the updated pages are being discovered.

sources.label: Google guidance on site moves with URL changes

sections.title: Pricing for a refresh or a Growth Site
paragraphs: The published Website Refresh is $1,000 for an agreed refresh scope. A Growth Site starts at $2,500 for a 5–10 page website. The right package depends on your existing content, page structure and required functionality.

Your proposal confirms the pages, integrations, account arrangements and delivery date. Hosting, domain renewals, photography and third-party subscriptions are discussed during scoping so you can plan the full project cost.

questions.question: Can you redesign my existing website?
questions.answer: Yes. Send your website address and explain what you want visitors to do. We review the current structure, platform and integrations, then recommend the design and content changes that fit your priorities.

questions.question: How do you assess whether the design is working?
questions.answer: We agree the important actions, test the contact journey and review available visits and enquiry data. Your offer, traffic quality and follow-up also influence the enquiries the website produces.

questions.question: How are website maintenance and ongoing SEO priced?
questions.answer: Website maintenance is quoted as a separate service for agreed support and updates. Ongoing search work is available through the Core AI Visibility Retainer at $1,500 per month with a three-month minimum, then month to month.

title: AI search optimization and AEO services
description: AEO and GEO services for local businesses. Improve technical access, useful content and ChatGPT search visibility with Picshaw's audit and monthly programme.
intro: Help people researching your services find clear, useful information about your business. Picshaw's AI search optimization work brings together technical access, accurate business details, buyer-focused content and measurable enquiry paths.

sections.title: AEO and GEO built around your buyers' questions
paragraphs: Answer engine optimization (AEO), generative engine optimization (GEO) and LLM SEO describe related approaches to visibility in AI-powered search. We use one programme to address the practical work behind those goals, including accessible pages, clear service explanations and evidence a potential customer can evaluate.

Buyers may research a business through ChatGPT, Perplexity or Google AI Overviews. Your audit scope identifies the platforms, questions and market being reviewed. Google's guidance connects its generative search features with established SEO foundations, so our work starts with useful content and a sound website structure.

sources.label: Google guidance on generative AI search

sections.title: Improve the foundations for ChatGPT search visibility
paragraphs: We review robots rules, indexing directives, canonical URLs, sitemaps, readable content and crawlable links. Where access is available, we also investigate hosting restrictions that affect public pages. Findings become an ordered implementation plan with the affected URLs and the next action.

OpenAI provides OAI-SearchBot controls for ChatGPT search and GPTBot controls for potential training use. We review search access against the business's chosen settings and agree any proposed changes.

links.label: Read the ChatGPT search eligibility guide

sections.title: Create content that helps a customer choose
paragraphs: We turn real buying questions into useful service pages and guides. These explain what you do, who you serve, where you work, what the price includes and how to enquire. Each page needs a clear purpose and information your business can confirm.

The content plan uses genuine experience, authorised project examples and current business details. Design concepts carry a clear label. Any reported result includes its source and timeframe so readers can understand the evidence.
bullets: Specific service descriptions and practical answers to buyer questions.
Consistent business information across the agreed sources.
Relevant internal links and an easy route to enquire.
Structured data that reflects the visible, accurate page content.

sections.title: Use monthly evidence to choose the next improvement
paragraphs: Core includes a repeatable sample of approximately 20 buyer questions across ChatGPT and Google AI experiences, one agreed page or guide each month, scoped access and listing checks, and a 30-minute reporting walkthrough. The report records test dates, markets, observed mentions and linked sources.

Available search and analytics data helps us review identifiable AI referrals, landing-page visits and qualified enquiries. These observations guide the next round of technical or content work. Platform coverage beyond the published Core scope is agreed in your proposal.

questions.question: Can AI search optimization guarantee inclusion in an answer?
questions.answer: Each search platform decides what appears, and results vary with the question, market, sources and date. Our commitment covers the agreed technical and content work, documented observations and reporting.

questions.question: How do AEO services work with my existing SEO?
questions.answer: We review your current pages, access controls and available search data first. The plan builds on that foundation with relevant buyer questions, accurate business information and AI-search observation alongside your existing search measurement.

questions.question: How is the work priced?
questions.answer: A single-location AI Visibility Audit is $1,250. The Core AI Visibility Retainer is $1,500 per month for one location and one primary market, with a three-month minimum, then month to month. Website redesign receives its own written scope.

title: Local SEO services in Los Angeles and Orange County
description: Local SEO services for Los Angeles and Orange County businesses. Improve service pages, business listings and technical foundations with a measured monthly plan.
eyebrow: Local search optimization · LA & Orange County
intro: Help nearby customers find your services and take the next step. Picshaw supports businesses serving Los Angeles and Orange County with local SEO work grounded in their actual services, coverage areas and enquiry goals.

sections.title: Start with the services and areas you want to grow
paragraphs: We review your priority services, real coverage area and the enquiries you want to receive. Available Search Console data and important page checks help identify opportunities in technical access, service content and the contact journey. This creates a baseline for the work that follows.

A business serving one primary market may need a focused set of page improvements. A company covering several locations may need a broader structure and reporting scope. We agree the market, pages and access requirements before recommending the programme.

sections.title: Service pages that answer local buying questions
paragraphs: We organise content around distinct services and the questions customers ask before contacting you. A useful service-area page explains where you work, the jobs you take and any genuine local information that helps someone decide whether your business is a fit.

The scope can include page titles, descriptions, headings, internal links, canonical URLs and a sitemap. Copy connects those foundations to a practical next step, such as calling about availability or requesting an estimate. Genuine project details strengthen the page when they are available.

links.label: Explore landing pages for services and local offers

sections.title: Connect business profiles with the website
paragraphs: We check business information across the agreed sources, which can include Google Business Profile, Apple Maps, Bing and relevant directories. Consistent contact details, service descriptions and website destinations help customers move from a listing to useful information about your business.

Google Business Profile upkeep starts with eligibility, verification and appropriate access. For an eligible profile, the agreed work can include service information, a post or update, and review-response drafts for your approval. The website and profile use the locations and coverage areas your business can confirm.

sections.title: A local SEO programme with clear monthly work
paragraphs: The Core AI Visibility Retainer is $1,500 per month with a three-month minimum, then month to month. It covers one location and one primary market, combining scoped local search foundations, eligible profile upkeep, one useful page or guide each month and AI visibility measurement.

A monthly report and 30-minute walkthrough connect the completed work with available search visits, identifiable referrals and qualified enquiries. We use that evidence to choose the next priorities. Additional locations or primary markets receive a tailored scope.

links.label: Explore the monthly AI Visibility Retainer

questions.question: Can you help a business serving both LA and Orange County?
questions.answer: Yes. Share your actual service areas and priority locations. We assess the page and listing work required, then confirm the market coverage in the proposal. Core covers one location and one primary market.

questions.question: When is a dedicated service-area page useful?
questions.answer: A dedicated page earns its place when it adds specific information about the services, coverage or work in that area. We review the customer need and available evidence before adding it to the content plan.

questions.question: How will I know what local SEO is achieving?
questions.answer: We document the completed work and review available search and enquiry data against the starting baseline. Search positions vary with the query, location and competition, so the review also considers the relevance of the visits and conversations reaching your business.

title: Web design for contractors and home-service businesses
description: Contractor websites with clear services, mobile-friendly contact options and useful quote forms. Picshaw serves local businesses from Los Angeles.
intro: Show people what you do, where you work and how to request an estimate. Picshaw designs websites around the practical questions a homeowner asks before getting in touch.

sections.title: Make the first screen earn its place
paragraphs: Our starting point is straightforward: name the trade, explain the service area and make the next step obvious. A homeowner with a leaking pipe should not have to interpret a vague slogan before finding out whether you can help.

For a plumbing business, an illustrative first screen might identify the plumbing services offered, give the actual coverage area and provide a tap-to-call option plus an estimate request. Emergency availability should appear only when the business genuinely provides it. This is a design example, not a measured client outcome.

sections.title: Ask for enough information—not everything
paragraphs: A useful enquiry form can ask for contact details, the type of job and the location information needed to decide whether it is in scope. Photos or scheduling integrations may help some businesses, but those features should be scoped rather than promised by default.
Before launch, test where messages arrive, how errors are explained and what the customer sees after submission. Do not display a successful confirmation when no enquiry has been delivered.
bullets: Clear service navigation on a small screen.
A working phone link using the business's real number.
An estimate request with explicit required fields.
Honest availability and response expectations.

sections.title: Use proof you can stand behind
paragraphs: Use your actual project photographs with permission, describe the work accurately and include credentials only when they are current and applicable. Testimonials should be genuine and authorised.

Picshaw's homepage includes labelled design concepts to demonstrate design direction. They are not customer case studies or evidence of increased bookings. A project case study should be added only when the client, work and any reported outcomes are verified.

sections.title: Choose the scope around the business
paragraphs: The $1,000 Website Refresh may suit an established site whose existing content needs a stronger presentation and enquiry path. A Growth Site from $2,500 is the published option for a 5–10 page website with a broader service structure.

Roofers, landscapers, plumbers and other trades have different information needs. We review the existing website and agree which pages and functionality are needed; there is no assumption that every trade needs the same template.

questions.question: Can I keep my current domain?
questions.answer: Often yes. We review the existing domain, hosting and email arrangements before agreeing a migration so the website change does not assume those services can be moved together.

questions.question: Can you add online booking or job-management software?
questions.answer: We can assess the integration you need. Compatibility, subscription costs and implementation effort must be confirmed in the scope; they are not automatically included in the refresh.

questions.question: What should I send for a review?
questions.answer: Your current website address, your main services and the areas you actually cover. Explain whether your priority is calls, estimate requests or a different action.

title: Google Business Profile optimization for local businesses

intro: Make it easier for a nearby customer to understand your business and get in touch. Picshaw helps eligible local businesses keep their Google Business Profile information useful, accurate and connected to the website.

sections.title: Start with an accurate, accessible business profile

Our profile upkeep work starts with an eligible, verified Google Business Profile and agreed management access. We review access and verification status during scoping, identify the person approving changes and confirm the locations covered by the work.

sections.title: Profile improvements tied to your real services
paragraphs: The agreed scope focuses on information a customer uses when comparing businesses. We use your confirmed details and genuine customer experience to prepare changes, with the website providing fuller service explanations and a clear enquiry route.
bullets: Review contact details, business hours, service information and the website destination.
Prepare an agreed post or profile update using accurate business information.
Develop relevant customer-question content where profile features support it.
Draft responses to genuine customer reviews for your approval.
Check that the linked page explains the service and provides a working next step.

sections.title: A review and approval process you can follow

The review records completed work and any updates awaiting access, approval or processing. We also look at the available website visits and enquiries associated with the profile, helping you decide which service information or contact steps need attention next.

sections.title: How profile upkeep fits the monthly programme
paragraphs: Google Business Profile upkeep is part of the published Core AI Visibility Retainer for an eligible, verified and accessible profile. Core is $1,500 per month for one location and one primary market, with a three-month minimum, then month to month.

Core also includes scoped website access checks, one useful page or guide each month, AI visibility testing and reporting. A focused profile request receives a written scope based on the access and changes required. Additional locations are quoted around their coverage needs.

links.label: See the Core deliverables and pricing

questions.question: Can you work with our existing Google Business Profile?
questions.answer: Yes. Send the public profile link, website address and location you want reviewed. We confirm eligibility, verification status and the management access required before agreeing the work.

questions.question: Who approves posts and review responses?
questions.answer: Your designated business contact approves the drafts using the agreed workflow. Service details and review responses reflect information your business can confirm and the customer's genuine experience.

questions.question: What should I expect from profile optimization?
questions.answer: Expect an agreed set of information improvements and a record of completed work. Google determines profile presentation and search positions. We review the available visits and enquiries to understand how customers are using the information.

title: Technical SEO services for small business websites
description: Technical SEO audits and scoped fixes for small business websites. Review crawlability, indexing, page structure and mobile performance with Picshaw.
intro: Give your service pages a sound foundation for discovery and a usable experience on mobile. Picshaw reviews the technical issues affecting your website, prioritises the findings and scopes the fixes around your business goals.

sections.title: Find the issue behind weak search visibility
paragraphs: A technical SEO review starts with your important pages and available search data. We examine whether the intended public URLs can be reached, understood and followed through the site, then investigate the controls or page behaviour that may be affecting discovery.

Tell us about recent redesigns, platform changes or pages that have stopped attracting visits. This context helps focus the investigation. The review records the URLs checked, the access available and the evidence behind each recommended change.

links.label: Read the guide to a website missing from Google

sections.title: Technical SEO checks with practical deliverables
paragraphs: The scope concentrates on the pages that explain your offer and lead to enquiries. Findings identify the affected page or setting, the proposed improvement and the access needed to complete it.
bullets: Review robots rules, indexing directives, canonical URLs and sitemap coverage.
Check readable page content, headings, titles, descriptions and crawlable internal links.
Inspect relevant redirects and links when existing page addresses change.
Review mobile layout and loading behaviour on the agreed pages.
Check that relevant structured data reflects visible, accurate business information.

sections.title: Prioritise, implement and check the agreed fixes
paragraphs: We order the findings around the importance of the affected pages, the evidence available and the effort involved. A blocked service page may need early attention, while a wider change to navigation or page templates needs a more detailed implementation scope.

The proposal confirms which fixes Picshaw will implement and which need your hosting provider or another account owner. After agreed changes, we recheck the affected pages and contact journey. Available Search Console data supports follow-up on discovery and indexing as search systems process the updates.

links.label: Plan a website design or redesign project

sections.title: Scope technical work around the website you have
paragraphs: Technical SEO implementation is quoted around the pages, platform, access and fixes required. The $1,250 single-location AI Visibility Audit includes a broader review of search access, business accuracy, buyer questions and the enquiry path, with a documented action plan.

Ongoing key-page access and indexing checks form part of Core at $1,500 per month with a three-month minimum, then month to month. Larger technical rebuilds receive a project scope that defines the implementation and launch responsibilities.

questions.question: Can you improve technical SEO on our current website?
questions.answer: The review identifies changes that fit your current platform and access. Send the website address and describe any recent changes or search concerns so we can assess the appropriate scope.

questions.question: What do we receive from the review?
questions.answer: You receive documented findings for the agreed pages, supporting evidence and prioritised actions. The proposal identifies the implementation work, account access and follow-up checks included in the engagement.

questions.question: How does technical SEO support AI-search visibility?
questions.answer: The work reviews the accessible content and search foundations used by discovery systems. Our AEO service adds buyer-question content, business-information checks and sampled AI-search observations to that technical starting point.

title: Landing page design for local businesses
description: Landing page design for services, local offers and enquiry campaigns. Picshaw builds mobile-first pages with focused copy, quote forms and clear next steps.
intro: Give visitors a useful destination for the service or offer that brought them to you. Picshaw designs focused landing pages that explain the offer, answer buying questions and make the next step easy to take.

sections.title: One page built around one customer decision
paragraphs: A landing page can support a particular service, genuine service area or seasonal offer. We start by agreeing the audience, how visitors will arrive and the action you want them to take. That might be a phone call, an estimate request or an availability enquiry.

The page then gives the customer enough information to act. A service page can explain the work involved and the next steps. An area page can describe actual coverage and relevant project experience. A seasonal offer needs clear terms, timing and a working contact route.

links.label: Connect service pages with a local SEO plan

sections.title: Design and copy that support the enquiry
paragraphs: The design brings the offer, genuine evidence and contact options together in a mobile-first layout. We organise the copy around the questions that affect the decision, using business details and claims you can confirm.
bullets: A clear headline that identifies the service and customer benefit.
Useful detail about scope, coverage, process and relevant pricing.
Authorised project images or testimonials where they are available.
A focused call-to-action with click-to-call links or an agreed enquiry form.
Page titles, descriptions and internal links that fit the wider website.

sections.title: From an agreed brief to a tested live page
paragraphs: We review your existing website and the offer, then agree the page structure, required content and contact action. You provide the business facts and available assets. The design and copy go through the agreed review process before publication.

Launch checks cover mobile layout, links, required form fields, message delivery and the confirmation a customer sees. Basic analytics setup can support the agreed measurement. After launch, available visits and enquiry data help identify whether the offer or contact journey needs further improvement.

sections.title: A scope based on content and functionality
paragraphs: Landing page work is quoted around the content, design, form and any integration required. The proposal confirms the page, review process, access and delivery date. Tell us about existing booking tools or quote systems during the brief so we can assess the connection.

For a broader website project, Picshaw's Website Refresh is $1,000 for an agreed refresh scope. The Growth Site starts at $2,500 for a 5–10 page website. We can assess how a new landing page fits those wider website priorities.

links.label: Compare website design and redesign options

questions.question: Can the landing page sit on my current website?
questions.answer: Often yes. We review your platform, page structure and access before agreeing the implementation. The design can follow your existing brand while giving the particular offer a focused presentation.

questions.question: What should I provide for the brief?
questions.answer: Send the offer, audience, actual coverage area and the action you want visitors to take. Include your current website, confirmed pricing, available images and the details needed to handle an enquiry.

questions.question: How do you measure landing page performance?
questions.answer: We agree the important action and review the available traffic and enquiry data. Traffic quality, offer clarity and your follow-up affect outcomes, so we use the evidence to guide subsequent changes.
